name: Limelight
source:
Oliver is back to his college after the tragic death of his roommate Luke. Luke's sister and ex-boyfriend are organizing a memorial screening at an old movie theater. Only, things quickly get out of control, and soon Oli and his friends find themselves terrorized by a shadowy presence.

[From [url=https://rotshild.itch.io/limelight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥利弗在室友卢克不幸去世后回到了大学。卢克的姐姐和前男友正在一家老电影院组织一场纪念放映。只是，事情很快就失去了控制，很快奥利和他的朋友们发现自己被一个阴暗的存在吓坏了。

[来自[url=https://rotshild.itch.io/limelight]Itch.io[/url]]
